title: Codec lineage, ACIS evidence tiers, and current candidate screen
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source web research and local plan reconciliation; research only
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Expand the open-source DWG/DXF comparator screen to current Rust codec, application-consumer, and geometry-kernel projects.
Resolve actual application-to-codec-to-kernel source pins where public manifests permit.
Separate ACIS byte parsing, model/reference validation, analytic geometry, kernel B-rep construction, and native acceptance.
Reconcile newly reviewed evidence with existing PAR-07/S8 and six external-only qualification items without adding implementation dependencies or routine validation cost.

sources.revision: Mutable current repository README and release listing reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The project publishes a direction-specific DWG/DXF version matrix, including unavailable AC1021 DWG writing. The matrix is a project declaration, not per-family run evidence.

sources.revision: Current repository source and 0.6.5 release listing reviewed 2026-10-19; earlier docs.rs package material used for the stated ACadSharp inspiration relationship
sources.observed: Current public README declares ASCII/Binary DXF and DWG R12-R2018+, 48 top-level entity variants, ACIS SAT/SAB parsing and writing, optional failsafe diagnostics, and Linux/Windows/macOS/WASM CI. The manifest does not show a direct ACadSharp runtime dependency. Earlier crate documentation describes ACadSharp as inspiration; this is correlated design lineage, not proof of shared source code. Declared support and CI configuration do not establish successful per-family semantic interoperation.

sources.revision: Release v2026.42 and current mutable main manifests/source reviewed 2026-10-19; Cargo manifest reports package 2026.42.0
sources.observed: Current OpenCADStudio Cargo.toml pins package acadrust from HakanSeven12/opencadcodec at rev 0dcd5aa and opencadkernel at rev 98d012c, plus opencadgraph at c0e16d6. The current main manifest is not by itself proof that a release installer was built from those exact dependency commits. opencadkernel describes itself as early and says most operations are unwritten; its ACIS feature depends on opencadcodec.

sources.revision: Issue pages and current release listing reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: Issue #1078 reports Layout-object corruption/recovery in v2026.36 and carries a maintainer statement that a main-branch change fixed entity-header and Layout field ordering/widths and retained AcDs links, with issue-specific semantic counts. This is a report and branch-fix claim, not an independently reproduced or release-bound result. Current issue-list title #1896 reports an AC1027 ACIS-solid read failure at one type code; its exact issue body/reproducer was unavailable, so no root cause or local defect can be inferred.

sources.revision: Mutable current project documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; no package or kernel executed
sources.observed: The project calls itself experimental, documents selected SAT versions and SAB/ASM profiles, retains unsupported records, and raises conversion errors outside its geometry subset. Shape conversion targets CadQuery/Open CASCADE, which is the same kernel family used by FreeCAD; it is not an independent kernel-family vote for FreeCAD semantics.

sources.revision: docs.rs 0.3.11 API and linked current SAB/ASM profile documentation reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The Rust-owned model exposes a bounded SAB/ASM reader, raw records, reference-closure validation, and analytic helpers without CadQuery or an external parser dependency. Its own API states that reference closure does not prove B-rep validity or producer/Inventor/ASM compatibility and that it does not construct OCCT solids. This supports a lower parser/model evidence tier only.

sources.revision: Mutable current repository README and architecture pages reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The project identifies itself as a safe Rust FFI over LibreDWG and declares read-only DWG/DXF-to-model/JSON/SVG/PNG routes. It may supply a different binding or projection observation but is not an independent DWG codec or writer.

sources.revision: Official current data-exchange discussion and component-boundary statement reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: OCCT's own data-exchange matrix places ACIS SAT/SAB read/write in a commercial component, distinct from the open-source default. Any entitlement-based run must be labeled as a commercial route.

sources.revision: Existing issue and current project README reviewed for cross-reference only
sources.observed: The existing plan already records issue #1411 as a version/build-scoped report of R2013+ AcDs SAB loss. This pass did not reproduce or reclassify that report.

localEvidence: The plan already distinguishes peer declaration, code/test evidence, binary parsing, retained carrier, writer output, independent reopen, ACIS semantics, and native-consumer acceptance.

The plan already records cq-acis as experimental and OCCT as a commercial ACIS exchange boundary; this pass sharpens their kernel-family relationship and adds acis-core's lower model/reference-validation tier.
Current OpenCADStudio Cargo source binds an application to explicit codec and kernel commits, but a released binary's correspondence to those current-main pins remains unverified.
No reviewed peer issue or support declaration alone establishes a new libdxfrw defect or closes an external qualification gate.

assessment.planImpact: Adds source-pinned codec/consumer/kernel provenance and refines ACIS evidence ceilings. acadrust and its application consumers do not multiply independent codec votes; cq-acis shares the OCCT kernel family with FreeCAD; acis-core proves reference closure/analytic helper results only, not B-rep validity. No implementation defect, gate, support claim, or routine validation cost changes.

method.kind: Read primary project repositories, source manifests, release pages, issue reports, docs.rs API documentation, then crosswalk claims to the local plan
method.limitations: GitHub main/master manifests and issues are mutable. The current OpenCADStudio main Cargo pins are not bound here to a particular published installer; issue #1078's fix is a maintainer report, and issue #1896's body was unavailable. Feature declarations, API reference closure, kernel validity, independent semantic evidence, and native application acceptance remain separate. No peer behavior was independently reproduced.

implementationReadyChecks: At the existing optional composed peer checkpoint, bind the exact consumer artifact/tag, codec and kernel commits, build features, OS/runtime, input/output hashes, operation, direction, and source-object dispositions.

Do not count applications using the same codec, wrappers over LibreDWG, parsers inspired by a peer, or multiple OCCT-based consumers as independent codec/kernel votes without an explicit source-lineage review.

For ACIS, record exact SAT/SAB/ASM profile, source payload and AcDs owner/key join, parser diagnostics/unsupported records, full topology disposition, kernel construction/validity, analytic invariants, independent reopen, and native acceptance as separate outcomes.
Use acis-core only for bounded model/reference/analytic claims; use cq-acis only inside its documented experimental geometry profile and do not treat it as a separate kernel family from FreeCAD.

Keep local implementation slices on generated tests, strict touched-target build, focused selector, owning CTest, and scoped diff checks; do not add peer dependencies, external fixtures, native runs, or full suites to each slice.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 stay DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting until their specifically required independent evidence is acquired.
